Title: FIFO OR LIFO Question about DAMGE PREVENTIONs

Messages.Author: Beth Walz
Messages.Body:
The example: a vampire has three blood left, the attacking vampire uses a zip
gun which causes one point of damage and then uses DB rounds which causes
two additional points of damge. The three blooded vampire uses damage
prevention to prevent two points of blood loss of the total of three points.

Does this vampire go to the Torpor from one DB round or does it stay in
controlled with two blood left..

WHich points of damage is prevented first..?

FIFO, LIFO, etc... is there an order....

Thanks to anyone or TOM,

Beth and Chong

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <ewalz.236...@postbox.acs.ohio-state.edu>,

Beth Walz <ew...@postbox.acs.ohio-state.edu> wrote:
>The example: a vampire has three blood left, the attacking vampire uses a zip
>gun which causes one point of damage and then uses DB rounds which causes
>two additional points of damge. The three blooded vampire uses damage
>prevention to prevent two points of blood loss of the total of three points.
>

>WHich points of damage is prevented first..?

When damage is prevented the Vampire preventing the damage chooses which
damage to prevent. They invariably choose to prevent the Aggravated damage
first - tho' this is just wise, not mandatory.
